coordinateComparison: Corresponding vertex X coordinates match after reflection and scale normalization; Y/Z match without reflection. Maximum mean absolute residual is under 0.000004 source units. This identifies conversion differences, not independent reference-pixel calibration.
scope: Current graph Run selects ashe_run_walk; Run2 and Run3 remain available for future gait selection. Contextual transitions, events and lighting calibration are not implemented.
